name: lanis
description: Connect your LANIS school account to an external assistant with individually approved, revocable access.

interface.longDescription: Read homework, course entries, timetables, substitutions and calendar events from your LANIS account. Messages require separate permission. Every connection is approved in LANIS and can be revoked at any time.
